_comment: Bowman KB Agent draft, run 25 (Sun Nov 8 2026). NOT complete - universeComplete false (same as BOW14). 2013 is the no-logo year: no 2013 card carries a 1st logo; Mo's Oct 17 2026 ruling makes the first Bowman auto by checklist history the 1st (README; R9.7).

products.name: 2013 Bowman Draft
products.releaseNote: baseballcardpedia 'scheduled for release the week of November 13, 2013' + Sports Collectors Daily Bryant timeline 'Nov 13, 2013' [HIGH]

note: Derivation: every hobby Chrome prospect autograph of 2013 Bowman ('Autographed Chrome Prospects', BCP- 42), 2013 Bowman Chrome ('Autographed Prospects', BCA- 57, four printed BCP-) and 2013 Bowman Draft ('Chrome Autographed Prospects', BCA- 47) = 146 rows. Lists [HIGH]: Cardboard Connection and baseballcardpedia agree code-for-code on all three (42/42, 57/57, 47/47). Priors: each name searched (accent-folded, punctuation stripped) across the full text of the 12 prior-year pages (2012 Bowman / Chrome / Draft and 2011 Bowman / Chrome / 2010 Bowman from Cardboard Connection; 2011 Draft, 2010 Chrome, 2010 Draft, 2009 Bowman / Chrome / Draft from baseballcardpedia), read Nov 8 2026. Every hit was reviewed: base cards (Biddle, Walker, Skole, Asche, Arcia, Hak-Ju Lee, Owens, Meadows, Ciuffo, Unroe, Olson) or Team USA / USA 16U / AFLAC insert autos (Olson, Owens, McCullers, Lorenzen, Meadows, Ciuffo, Unroe, Buxton, Correa) - none on a Chrome prospect-auto list -> 146 true, 0 false, 0 held; 0 players with two 2013 hobby Chrome prospect autos. Excluded by the 08 §1 working rule: 2013 Bowman Retail Autographs BPA- (25, paper), Chrome rookie autos (Bowman 'Bowman Chrome Autographed Rookies', Chrome 'Autographed Rookies' 7, Draft CRA-YP), insert / dual / die-cut / Black / Ultimate / Fill the Bill / Rising thru the Ranks autos. Kris Bryant: a 2013 Bowman Draft BCA-KB card exists but was never in 2013 packs - first issued in 2014 Bowman Inception (Jun 27 2014), after his 2014 Bowman BCAP-KB (May 2014) - so he is BOW14 (row true there), not BOW13 [MED: Sports Collectors Daily timeline; baseballcardpedia 2013 Draft note]. Open before universeComplete: (1) the 2011 Bowman Chrome prior list is a Cardboard Connection 'updated autograph checklist' (may be partial); 2012 Bowman (38), 2011 Bowman (34), 2010 Bowman (31) single-source (same as BOW14); (2) teams not read (not required by the schema); (3) consoles not read - SportsCardsPro slugs for 2013 to verify before any mark; (4) the insert-auto question (Team USA / AFLAC) is G61 for Mo.
